args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — verified successful.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.
